title: Cyclotron lab verifier registration for Papyrus site tokens
description: Dedicated verifier role cyclotron-lab-verifier (Cyclotron account 682849160744) registered here to call only identities/me and accounts/*/authorize for tokens of the Papyrus sites in accounts/papyrus-sites.json. Authorization is evaluated as product cyclotron (active entitlement plus active membership; console:read and console:write capped by role). Cyclotron ticket: I2 Prospectus lab verifier role for Papyrus site tokens. Approved in principle by Ryan 2026-10-21 as option A. Committed disabled until Cyclotron deploys the role.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-21: enabled in Prospectus. #72 (1db86a5, shipped disabled) and #73 (2675516, Amplify job 71), with Ryan approving the exact resource-policy diff: an Allow for arn:aws:iam::682849160744:role/cyclotron-lab-verifier on GET /v1/identities/me and POST /v1/accounts/*/authorize, plus a Deny exemption. Left in_progress until Cyclotron's end-to-end acceptance with LabVerifierEnabled=true.
